positiveControlNote: The positive control is control-only. It proves the decision procedure can reach INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED under a caller-supplied verifier and a distinct public-key root. It does not establish a real independent party, and it is excluded from the real aggregate of 0 independently verified envelopes.
